cards.prompt: What physical root cause underlies myopia?
cards.answer: A slightly elongated eyeball, so light focuses in front of the retina.

cards.prompt: Glasses, contact lenses and surgery help myopia, but they do not fix what?
cards.answer: The underlying cause: the elongated eyeball.

cards.prompt: What has research found crucial for children's eye health?
Only 10-20% of Chinese were short sighted sixty years ago; today up to ____% of adults are.
Both parents have no myopia but their kid develops it. What other cause might explain this?
cards.answer: Environmental factors: little outdoor time and lots of near work like reading and screens.

cards.prompt: Genes alone explain the myopia boom of recent decades.
cards.answer: False: genes can't be the whole story; lifestyle changes matter.
